name: Prathamesh More
summary: Data Scientist with 4+ years of experience in AI/ML and Generative AI, specializing in Agentic AI systems and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). Hands-on experience building multi-agent architectures with autonomous orchestration, hybrid retrieval pipelines, and schema-driven answer generation grounded strictly in retrieved context. Proficient in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, and vector databases.

education.institution: JSPM’s Rajarshi Shahu College of Engineering

skills.items: Logistic Regression, Linear Regression, SVMs, Decision Trees, KNN, Ensembles, ANN, RNN, LSTM, CNN
Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn, Keras, TensorFlow
LangChain, LangGraph, DeepAgents, Tokenization, Chunking, Embedding

description: Building a scalable Multi-Agent platform using the DeepAgents framework (LangGraph-based), where LLM agents autonomously discover skills via SKILL.md instructions, execute Text2SQL and RAG workflows through a middleware-driven tool-calling architecture, and dynamically classify and route queries—replacing hard-coded conditional edges with LLM-driven orchestration.

Designed a two-stage RAG pipeline with hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense vectors via Milvus), Reciprocal Rank Fusion, Coherereranking, and source-balanced chunk selection—paired with a document ingestion pipeline using Docling and PyMuPDF parsers to handle heterogeneous PDFs with contextual chunking and domain-specific metadata enrichment.

Built a production-resilient middleware stack—circuit breakers, rate limiters, protocol parsers for reasoning-model quirks, and agent flow loggers—integrated with OpenAI embeddings, gpt-oss-120b for complex reasoning, and PostgreSQL as the transactional SQL backend.

Developed schema-driven answer generation with YAML-based formatting rules, answer-type routing (comparison, causal, procedural, factual), and inline citation enforcement—grounding every response strictly in retrieved context to eliminate hallucination.
Developed an enterprise-grade RAG-based chatbot capable of retrieving and synthesizing information from 4,000+ heterogeneous PDFs containing structured and unstructured content.
Built secure, modular pipelines using LangChain and Azure services, incorporating authentication, access control, and environment-specific configurations.
Utilized OpenAI embedding models with Chroma VectorDB and GPT-4o; evaluated system quality using relevancy scoring between ground truth answers and generated responses.
Implemented agentic RAG with query decomposition, context validation, and iterative retrieval, improving answer accuracy by 4%.
Added multilingual query and response support, increasing user adoption and traffic by 11%.
Developed and deployed predictive ML models including a Policy Compliance Tracker and Card Limit Optimizer for enterprise financial workflows.
Performed end-to-end data preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis to improve data quality and model robustness.
Automated compliance monitoring workflows, improving detection accuracy by 16% and reducing operational monitoring costs by 18%.
Collaborated closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into ML solutions, iteratively refining models based on real-world feedback.
Enhanced end-user experience and system usability, contributing to an 8% increase in positive feedback and up to 12% cost savings through process optimization.
